referenceFunction.generalComment: Assumption for the construction of the canal are derived from the Main-Donau-Canal in Germany. The canal is characterised by a width of 42 m and a average depth of 4m. Life time of port is assumed to be 118 years. ; UUID: 859a7f0f-5f90-39f0-bd83-6012c40ba1ee
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This inventory comprises the construction canals in Germany. The inventory calls processes of material production, representing the material used in the construction phase of the canal. Also lorry transport of materials to and from the constructions site has been taken into account. Expenditures due to disposal are excluded. Also expenditures for the construction of bridges are excluded.
referenceFunction.name: Canal

geography.text: Data is based on a case study of one canal in Germany.

representativeness.extrapolations: Data calculated for one canal in Germany is used as an estimate for Europe.
